hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 003 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until hyper-accuracy review and matching rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Help AI/SaaS buyers compare tiers while making the recommended plan visually unavoidable.
purposeLayer: Pricing section turns abstract AI value into purchasable packages with a glowing central recommendation.
anatomyLayer: Section heading, three pricing cards, tier names, price/custom label, feature checklist, CTA buttons, and central highlighted plan.
hierarchyLayer: Section heading first, highlighted middle tier second, side tiers third, feature lists fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Three-card row on dark background with central card larger/brighter and side cards dimmer.
densityLimitLayer: Use 2-4 tiers, one featured tier, 4-8 features per tier, and one CTA per tier.
originalityLayer: Learn featured-tier neon emphasis; transform glow language, tier count, feature density, and CTA hierarchy.
usageRuleLayer: Use for AI, SaaS, software, membership, subscription, and service package pricing sections.
layoutGesture: neon pricing row with amplified center tier
sectionSilhouette: three dark cards with glowing middle recommendation
compositionTension: pricing comparison tension created by bright center plan versus dim side plans
focalPath: heading to featured middle tier to side-tier comparison to CTA
negativeSpaceShape: dark spacing pockets between glowing pricing cards
depthLayering: dark cards, neon borders, central glow depth, button highlights
moduleScaleVariation: one larger highlighted tier flanked by smaller cards
breakoutBehavior: featured card glows beyond its boundaries
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact prices, plan names, purple glow treatment, feature copy, or card dimensions.
